Hoe donkerder, hoe langer een zaak in di: The darker, the longer a case stays in that phase. A phase adds up the days of all its statuses: for Woo request, Search documents, Assess documents and Redact sit together under Assessment; for Social assistance application, Assistance running and Reintegration running sit together under Execution. A status without a phase sits under its own name. Final statuses such as Closed form no column. Only finished stays count: an open case that went from Receipt to Assessment counts its two days of Receipt and nothing yet for Assessment.
